description:
Design a cozy outdoor conversation area in the backyard of the sample house project using NCH DreamPlan Home Design Software.

Your goal is to:
1. Open the 'Sample House' project (if not already loaded).
2. Navigate to the backyard area (behind the house).
3. Place a 'Fire Pit' object (found in Exterior/Landscaping/Outdoor Living categories) in the backyard.
4. Place at least two (2) 'Outdoor Chairs' (e.g., Adirondack, patio chairs, or benches) arranged near the fire pit to create a conversation group.
5. Save the project as 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\DreamPlan\FirePitProject.ndp'.
6. Take a screenshot of your design in 3D view and save it to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\DreamPlan\fire_pit_view.png'.
